name: Sketch
description: Sketch is a vector-based UI/UX design application for creating interface designs and interactive prototypes, with tools for developer handoff.
best_for: Positioned for professional UI/UX designers, from independent freelancers to enterprise design teams.

tiers.name: Mac-only License (one-time)
tiers.unit: per seat, includes 1 year of updates
tiers.notes: Local Mac app only -- no cloud collaboration, no online sharing, no iOS preview, and excluded from the 30-day free trial.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Billed yearly ($144/editor/year). Real-time collaboration, unlimited documents, unlimited free viewers, 50GB storage per editor.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Billed yearly. Adds SSO, project archiving, and permissions groups.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Billed yearly. Adds SCIM provisioning, BYOK encryption, dedicated support, and unlimited storage.

tiers.name: Private Cloud
tiers.notes: Contact for pricing. Isolated AWS-hosted environment with a choice of hosting location.

cons: Editing and designing is Mac-only (current macOS required) -- no native Windows or Linux editor exists; other platforms can only view or comment through the web app.
Subscription seat pricing of $12-44 per editor per month is quoted billed yearly -- the advertised per-editor rate requires an annual commitment.

The classic one-time-purchase license ($120/seat) still exists but is crippled compared to the subscription: no cloud collaboration, no online sharing, no iOS preview, and it is excluded from the 30-day free trial.
features: Nestable frames and flexible stack layouts for responsive design
Free developer handoff and inspection tools

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.description: A browser- and desktop-based design tool for interface design, prototyping, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need cross-platform access beyond macOS

alternatives.name: Canva
alternatives.description: An online visual design platform letting non-designers create graphics, presentations, and print materials from templates.
